title: Molecular dynamics unveils multiple-site binding of inhibitors with reduced activity on the surface of dihydrofolate reductase
authors: Mitsugu Araki; Toru Ekimoto; Kazuhiro Takemura; Shigeyuki Matsumoto; Yunoshin Tamura; Hironori Kokubo; Gert-Jan Bekker; Tsutomu Yamane; Yuta Isaka; Yukari Sagae; Narutoshi Kamiya; Mitsunori Ikeguchi; Yasushi Okuno
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和马尔可夫模型研究抑制剂与DHFR蛋白表面的多位点结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为小分子药物而非蛋白质-DNA，且无TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: The sensitivity to protein inhibitors is altered by modifications or protein mutations, as represented by drug resistance. The mode of stable drug binding to the protein pocket has been experimentally clarified. However, the nature of the binding of inhibitors with reduced sensitivity remains unclear at the atomic level. In this study, we analyzed the thermodynamics and kinetics of inhibitor binding to the surface of wild-type and mutant dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) using molecular dynamics simulations combined with Markov state modeling. A strong inhibitor of methotrexate (MTX) showed a preference for the active site of wild-type DHFR with minimal binding to unrelated (secondary) sites. Deletion of a side-chain fragment in MTX largely destabilized the active site-bound state, with clear evidence of binding to secondary sites. Similarly, the F31V mutation in DHFR diminished the specificity of MTX binding to the active site. These results reveal the presence of multiple-bound states whose stabilities are comparable to or higher than those of the unbound state, suggesting that a reduction in the binding affinity for the active site significantly elevates the fractions of these states. This study sheds light on the specific drug recognition by proteins and the selectivity of drug binding sites on protein surfaces. (199 words)
abstract_zh: 对蛋白质抑制剂的敏感性会因修饰或蛋白质突变而改变，这以耐药性为代表。稳定药物与蛋白质口袋结合的模式已在实验上得到阐明。然而，敏感性降低的抑制剂结合的本质在原子水平上仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用分子动力学模拟结合马尔可夫状态建模，分析了抑制剂与野生型和突变型二氢叶酸还原酶（DHFR）表面的结合热力学和动力学。强抑制剂甲氨蝶呤（MTX）偏好于野生型DHFR的活性位点，与非特异性（次级）位点的结合极少。MTX中侧链片段的缺失大幅破坏了活性位点结合态的稳定性，并明确显示出与次级位点的结合。同样，DHFR中的F31V突变削弱了MTX对活性位点结合的特异性。这些结果揭示了多种结合态的存在，其稳定性与未结合态相当或更高，表明对活性位点结合亲和力的降低显著提升了这些状态的比例。本研究揭示了蛋白质对药物的特异性识别以及药物在蛋白质表面结合位点的选择性。
